Rules for the answer:

Which year had the highest revenue, and how did it compare to the year before?

tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH ytot AS (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS INTEGER) AS year,
         ROUND(SUM(Total),2) AS revenue
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY year
), maxrev AS (
  SELECT MAX(revenue) AS max_revenue FROM ytot
)
SELECT y.year,
       y.revenue,
       COALESCE(p.revenue,0) AS previous_revenue,
       ROUND(y.revenue - COALESCE(p.revenue,0),2) AS absolute_change,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.revenue,0)=0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0*(y.revenue - p.revenue)/p.revenue,2) END AS pct_change,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ytot WHERE revenue = (SELECT max_revenue FROM maxrev)) AS tie_count
FROM ytot y
LEFT JOIN ytot p ON p.year = y.year - 1
WHERE y.revenue = (SELECT max_revenue FROM maxrev)
ORDER BY y.year DESC;"}

WITH ytot AS (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS INTEGER) AS year,
         ROUND(SUM(Total),2) AS revenue
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY year
), maxrev AS (
  SELECT MAX(revenue) AS max_revenue FROM ytot
)
SELECT y.year,
       y.revenue,
       COALESCE(p.revenue,0) AS previous_revenue,
       ROUND(y.revenue - COALESCE(p.revenue,0),2) AS absolute_change,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.revenue,0)=0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0*(y.revenue - p.revenue)/p.revenue,2) END AS pct_change,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ytot WHERE revenue = (SELECT max_revenue FROM maxrev)) AS tie_count
FROM ytot y
LEFT JOIN ytot p ON p.year = y.year - 1
WHERE y.revenue = (SELECT max_revenue FROM maxrev)
ORDER BY y.year DESC;
